text:
Maria C: Hi team — uploading the co-branded one-pager tile and the AWS Marketplace listing draft from VectorGrid. Need quick checks: logo badge, alt text, and whether we can publish the customer quote. Files: https://drive.redwood.com/VectorGrid/co-brand/tile_v1.png and https://docs.redwood.com/marketplace/vectorgrid-listing-draft.md
Samir D: looking now — can you also drop the raw SVG for their logo? the PNG looks a bit low-res for the hero tile :eyes:
Maria C: uploaded `vectorgrid_logo.svg` to the same folder — link above
Chris M: quick marketing pass: suggested alt text for tile: `Redwood + VectorGrid: low-latency inference on hybrid GPU clusters` — ok to use this?
Lee (Legal): need to confirm trademark usage — are we using their exact logotype or the approved lockup? send me the VectorGrid brand guidelines pdf
Jenna (Solutions Eng): also flag: the quote in the draft is attributed to "VectorGrid CTO" but we need the person's full name and permission. Do we have signed approval from them?
Maria C: we have an email from Alya (VectorGrid) approving the summary language but not the quote attribution. forwarding thread to @Lee (Legal)
Lee (Legal): thanks. I need: 1) brand guidelines PDF, 2) written permission for the quote with full name and title, 3) confirmation we can use their logo SVG in co-branded assets. I'll DM Alya template if needed.
assets-bot: Automated asset QA: missing alt text for marketplace screenshot (1), SVG checked (OK), contrast ratio low on small CTA text (needs fix) :warning:
Samir D: I'll bump the CTA weight and upload a v2 by EOD. Also tighten the logo spacing — VectorGrid requires 24px clearspace per guidelines.
Chris M: once we have the signed quote and updated tile I'll prep the marketplace meta and short blurb. For marketplace icons, we should use the monochrome lockup — can someone confirm that's allowed?
Lee (Legal): confirm monochrome lockup is in their guidelines? If yes and covered in permission, we're good. Otherwise we need explicit approval.
Maria C: next steps: Samir to upload v2, Lee to get signed quote/permission, Chris to prep marketplace copy. I'll track in the partner asset tracker: https://notion.redwood.com/p/partner-assets/vectorgrid
Samir D: noted — will post update `tile_v2.png` when ready :white_check_mark:
